body.x: Yo-Kai Express, a Silicon Valley-based food tech company, unveiled YKE Desktop, a compact cooking machine using RFID (radio frequency identification) for on-demand ramen, at CES 2023. Its iconic ramen vending machine also returned while bringing new menus through new partnerships.

Yo-Kai Express provides an autonomous restaurant platform that serves contactless, freshly prepared meals with over 20 menu varieties 24 hours a day. Its ramen vending machine in the line-up creates hot ramen noodles on-demand, just like those served at street-side restaurants. It also introduced a new product named YKE Desktop, a semi-automatic cooking machine that can prepare ramen in 90 seconds. Perfect for small spaces with space restrictions, the YKE Desktop is pairable with an RFID freezer that can store 20-24 bowls.

body.cap: JINYA Ramen Bar's ramen cooked from the vending machine | Photo by AVING News

body.x: For the first time, Yo-Kai Express served samples of meals with its machines to visitors at CES. Visitors got a sneak peek and taste of a new menu from JINYA Ramen Bar, one of the most extensive ramen chains in the US, ahead of the public launch in February 2023. It served four menu options: Tonkotsu Ramen, Spicy Tonkotsu Ramen, Vegan Ramen, and Spicy Chicken Paitan Ramen. Visitors also tasted a non-GMO plant-based Korean Galbi rice bowl by Pulmuone foods, a leading global Korean food provider.

body.cap: YKE Desktop, a compact ramen cooking machine using RFID | Photo by AVING News

body.x: "We are pleased to debut our new product: Yo-Kai Desktop, the new terminal with a smaller form factor, which fits anywhere - remote office, gas station, convenience stores, co-working space," said Andy Lin, the founder, and CEO of Yo-Kai Express. "It's a semi-automated machine that provides our customers more flexibility. In addition, we are thrilled to partner with well-established restaurateurs on the Yo-Kai global platform to expand their presence in the market."

In addition, the company previewed its consumer-facing app that enables customers to use their phones to place orders remotely and earn loyalty points, discounts, and rewards. The app plans to launch in the Spring of 2023.
